paper_id: Zhao et al. - 2007 - VIRE Active RFID-based Localization Using Virtual Reference Elimination
title: VIRE: Active RFID-based Localization Using Virtual Reference Elimination
motivation: LANDMARC在密闭多径环境中表现差，增加参考标签成本高且会引发RF干扰
problem_framing: 如何在不增加额外参考标签的情况下提升室内定位精度
key_insight: 通过线性插值生成虚拟参考标签,结合消除算法过滤不可能位置
method_signature: 虚拟参考标签+邻近图+阈值消除+加权坐标计算
evaluation_criteria: 与LANDMARC对比,在三种环境下测试9个跟踪标签的估计误差
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 线性插值在复杂情况下不够精确,多项式插值在端点处可能不准确;需要方形真实网格
evidence_for_taste: linear interpolation is fast and easy. But it is not very precise
polynomial interpolation may not be so exact after all
The density of the tags cannot be too dense
If the threshold is too big, many noisy virtual reference tags will be selected
finding an appropriate threshold is an important design parameter
thinking_moves: 从物理限制(标签干扰)反推不能无限增加参考标签
用插值生成虚拟标签来绕过物理部署的成本与干扰问题
将定位问题重新frame为多阅读器的交集消除问题
通过自适应阈值迭代找到最小可能区域
